hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); CONTENT=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.content // ""'); case "$FILE" in *.js|*.jsx|*.ts|*.tsx) if printf '%s' "$CONTENT" | grep -qF 'console.log'; then echo 'Warning: console.log statements should be removed before committing' >&2; exit 2; fi ;; esac

INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); if [ "$FILE" = "package.json" ]; then echo 'Checking for vulnerable dependencies...'; npm audit --audit-level=moderate; fi
INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); case "$FILE" in *.js|*.jsx|*.ts|*.tsx) npx prettier --write "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true ;; esac

INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); case "$FILE" in *.js|*.jsx|*.ts|*.tsx) if grep -qF 'import * from' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null; then echo 'Warning: Avoid wildcard imports for better tree-shaking' >&2; exit 2; fi ;; esac

INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); case "$FILE" in *.test.*|*.spec.*) ;; *.js|*.jsx|*.ts|*.tsx) DIR=$(dirname "$FILE"); BASE=$(basename "$FILE" | sed 's/\.[^.]*$//'); for T in "$DIR/$BASE.test.js" "$DIR/$BASE.test.jsx" "$DIR/$BASE.test.ts" "$DIR/$BASE.test.tsx" "$DIR/$BASE.spec.js" "$DIR/$BASE.spec.ts"; do if [ -f "$T" ]; then echo "Running tests for $T..."; if command -v jest >/dev/null 2>&1; then npx jest "$T" --passWithNoTests; elif command -v vitest >/dev/null 2>&1; then npx vitest run "$T"; fi; break; fi; done ;; esac

if [ -f package.json ] && git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | grep -qE '\.(js|jsx|ts|tsx)$'; then echo 'Running linter on changed files...'; CHANGED=$(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR 2>/dev/null | grep -E '\.(js|jsx|ts|tsx)$' | tr '\n' ' '); if [ -n "$CHANGED" ]; then npx eslint $CHANGED 2>&1; fi; fi

if [ -f package.json ] && git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | grep -qE '\.(js|jsx|ts|tsx)$'; then echo 'Analyzing bundle size impact...'; if command -v bundlesize >/dev/null 2>&1; then npx bundlesize; elif npm list webpack-bundle-analyzer >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'Use: npx webpack-bundle-analyzer build/static/js/*.js'; else echo 'No bundle analysis tool found'; fi; fi

statusLine.command: bash -c 'input=$(cat); MODEL=$(echo "$input" | jq -r ".model.display_name"); DIR=$(echo "$input" | jq -r ".workspace.current_dir"); BRANCH=""; if git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then BRANCH=" | $(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null)"; fi; echo "[$MODEL] ${DIR##*/}$BRANCH"'
